cooldown.binNote: Bin FakedCooldown matches [10/9.5/9/8.5/8]; the ddragon top-level cooldown field lists 0 because Rend has no true cooldown timer (it is gated by requiring a Rend-stacked target in range) and uses FakedCooldown for tooltip/UX purposes.

mechanics.claim: Rend consumes all Rend stacks on nearby enemies to deal physical damage, dealing additional damage for each stack beyond the first.
mechanics.quote: consuming the stacks on each target to deal {{as|physical damage}}... For each stack beyond the first, the target is dealt additional {{as|physical damage}}

mechanics.claim: If Rend kills at least one target, its cooldown is reset and mana is partially refunded.
mechanics.quote: If ''Rend'' kills at least one target, its {{sti|cooldown}} is reset and '''Kalista''' restores {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}.

mechanics.claim: Rend deals reduced (50%) damage against epic monsters, irrelevant to a champion-type dummy target.
Casting Rend also empowers in-flight basic-attack and Pierce missiles to apply Rend's effects immediately on hit.
mechanics.quote: ''Rend's'' cast also empowers the in-flight missiles of '''Kalista's''' basic attacks and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' to apply ''Rend's'' effects to their targets immediately upon hitting them.

mechanics.claim: A valid enemy with a Rend stack in range is required to cast Rend at all.
mechanics.quote: ''A nearby enemy with a Rend stack is required to cast this ability.''

mechanics.claim: Rend applies its damage and effects instantly on cast rather than on a delay or missile travel time.
mechanics.quote: ''Rend'' applies its effects instantly on cast.
